item.title: Red Bull Theater Extends Run Of RICHARD II Starring Michael Urie
item.description: Red Bull Theater will extend its Off-Broadway engagement of RICHARD II through Sunday, December 21 at the Astor Place Theatre at 434 Lafayette Street due to audience demand.. The production marks the first show at Astor Place Theatre under the venue’s new management, No Guarantees Productions.
